summary: A local arts article previewing five upcoming music festivals and events in the city from September 2023 to January 2024. It covers the Heartland Music Fest, Night of Classics, Riverside Revel, Celebrate Folk Fest, and Jazz and Bites Weekend, noting headliners, venues, dates, and extras like markets, workshops, and food. The piece stresses how music events bring the community together and support emerging local artists.
one_line: Preview of five local music festivals from September 2023 to January 2024, spanning rock, classical, indie, folk, and jazz.
key_facts: The Heartland Music Fest takes place September 10, 2023, in Central Park, with local rock, jazz, and folk across up to three stages and over twenty-five acts.
The Eva Clayton Band headlines the Heartland Music Fest, known for soulful melodies and electrifying stage presence.
Alex Gomez, a 17-year-old drummer prodigy, will perform an experimental jazz fusion set at the Heartland Music Fest.
The Heartland Music Fest includes an artisan market, food trucks, and workshops from guitar basics to songwriting 101; gates open at noon.
Night of Classics is set for October 3, 2023, on the lawns of the Grandborough Cultural Centre, with the city orchestra performing classical pieces.
Conductor Christopher Marlow leads Night of Classics, and 22-year-old violinist Sofia Chen is to perform Bach and Tchaikovsky.
The Riverside Revel runs November 15-17, 2023, at Riverside Park and features indie artists; singer-songwriter Leon Bridges curates the line-up.
Independent music stores partner with Riverside Revel organizers to offer exclusive album releases and discounts, and the event includes panels, meet-and-greets, and a 'zine fair.
Celebrate Folk Fest is on December 5, 2023, at Logan Square, spotlighting local folk music with modern lyrical narratives.
The Whittaker Family Band returns to Celebrate Folk Fest, and Grace Elliot and Jonathan Moore play in the songwriter's circle.
Jazz and Bites Weekend runs January 14-16, 2024, in the historic downtown area, pairing jazz with culinary experiences from local chefs and food artisans.
Multi-Grammy nominee saxophonist Dylan Reid headlines Jazz and Bites Weekend, with the Collective Quintet also performing.
